drifts.title: Incremental Temporal Partition (transactions_2017q1.csv + identity_2017q1.csv)
drifts.what_breaks: 1) etl/build_db.py hardcodes filenames 'transactions.csv'/'identity.csv' and asserts count == 590,742. 2) Loading 2017q1 standalone resets card_seq to 1, destroys 2016 modal_region / recurring_amounts / prior_med_amt baselines, and orphans INVOLVES edges on all 5,565 historical closed cases.
drifts.remapping_action: Union the 590,742 Jul-Dec 2016 transactions with the 60,196 Jan 2017 transactions (650,938 total) before computing running window features (card_seq, prior_*, NEXT gap_seconds) and LightGBM cms_p scoring.

attestation.what: January 2017 arrives as a 60,196-row transaction delta (2017-01-01 00:00:20 to 2017-01-31 23:59:07) and 15,893 identity rows that must be unioned with the 590,742 Jul-Dec 2016 rows.

how.sql: SELECT TransactionID FROM txc WHERE TransactionID >= 3600000 LIMIT 25

drifts.title: Null/Empty card6 on 54 January 2017 Transactions Across 24 Customers

before_shape.card_rule: dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY coalesce(card6, ''))

drifts.what_breaks: In etl/card_rule.py, coalesce(card6, '') = '' sorts lexicographically BEFORE 'credit' and 'debit'. For a customer who only had 'debit' (-K1) in 2016 (e.g., C04096, C08563, C09148), a single NULL card6 row in Jan 2017 claims '-K1' for '' and shifts their real debit card to '-K2', corrupting card_id joins across 2016 and 2017.
drifts.remapping_action: Freeze existing 2016 card_id assignments from card_feat first; for Jan 2017 rows with card6 IS NULL, resolve to the customer's primary active card (or -K1) and record a DQ-03 taint on the transaction.

attestation.what: 54 January 2017 transactions across 24 customers have NULL/empty card6, which would shift dense_rank() card_id numbers without cardmap pinning.

drifts.title: Closed-Case History Replacement & New Analyst Note Template (CC-5566..CC-5585)

after_shape.new_note_prefix: Case HHG-0xx from the November-December review.

drifts.what_breaks: etl/parse_closed_cases.py enforces EXPECTED_TEMPLATES totaling 5,565 and regexes RE_FRAUD / RE_CLEARED. The 20 new rows CC-5566..CC-5585 use a new phrasing ('Case HHG-001 from the November-December review...') and fail strict template assertions.
drifts.remapping_action: Add template rules 'r1_review_fraud' and 'r1_review_cleared' to parse CC-5566..CC-5585, mask HHG-/CC-/card/amount tokens into embed_text, and generate 1024-d embeddings for the 20 new ClosedCase vertices.

attestation.what: closed_cases_history.csv grew from 5,565 to 5,585 rows; CC-5566..CC-5585 encode the 20 Round-1 outcomes in a new analyst_notes template.

how.sql: SELECT case_id FROM cc WHERE case_id >= 'CC-5566' ORDER BY case_id

drifts.title: Case Pack Schema Shift (HHF-001..HHF-018) & In-Person Identity Contradictions
drifts.what_breaks: 1) Hardcoded HHG- case filters and 20-case assertions in etl/build_db.py and ops/clear_case_writebacks.py reject HHF-001..018. 2) 3 in-person transactions (3660351..3660353 on HHF-008) carry online browser/OS/proxy identity rows while trigger_text falsely claims 'online'.
drifts.remapping_action: Support HHF-001..018 in case_pack loader, validator, and write-back cleaner; cross-check trigger_text claims against DB transaction columns and flag DQ-02 contradictions.
